Modifying the Codebase for the Course
We'll now implement some changes to our codebase so that they can better serve the purposes of this course:
Since we're fetching journal data from an API, we don't need a journal form right now. So, we'll remove JournalForm.jsx from our codebase.
Our EntryCard will no longer have the Edit and Delete buttons. You don't need them for this course.
Now, let's observe the changes on the next page.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
